name: Noclip
description: Experimental invisible wave early-input buffering, adjustable up to 300ms. Press and release correction requires a predicted safe path.

window-frames.name: Timing window (frames)
window-frames.description: Only for old learned reference timings (cube/other modes). Wave instead uses Wave early input buffer (milliseconds). Default 5 physics frames.

auto-learn.name: Learn inputs that survive
auto-learn.description: Saves input timing positions after surviving at least 12 simulation steps. This does not prove an input was perfect.

record-reference.name: Record reference timing (training)
record-reference.description: When on, delay is disabled and EVERY click/release is saved as a reference for the current level. Turn OFF after a clean practice run.

blind-delay.name: Delay unlearned inputs too (experimental)
blind-delay.description: When on, unfamiliar presses/releases are delayed by the full frame window. This IS NOT selective and may make timings worse.

platformer.name: Enable in platformer levels (experimental)
platformer.description: Platformer speed and direction changes can make timing anchors unreliable.

clear-learned.name: Clear all timing references
clear-learned.description: Toggle ON to permanently clear saved reference timings. Turn OFF again to resume learning.

predict-wave.name: Hidden wave trajectory correction (experimental)
predict-wave.description: Shape-aware hidden wave press/release timing assist (still experimental; not guaranteed perfect).

wave-horizon.name: Wave lookahead (frames)
wave-horizon.description: How far ahead to search for wave collisions in physics steps; the mod automatically raises this above the early buffer.

log-wave-decisions.name: Log wave decisions (debug)
log-wave-decisions.description: Log all jump inputs including early bypasses, wave collision scan, timing selection and actual buffered dispatch to Geode log. Enable for troubleshooting.

wave-direct-dispatch.name: Direct buffered wave dispatch (CBF compatibility)
wave-direct-dispatch.description: Send buffered wave presses/releases to PlayerObject directly instead of GJBaseGameLayer. This avoids CBF swallowing delayed inputs; disable if it conflicts with another input mod.

wave-early-buffer-ms.name: Wave early input buffer (milliseconds)
wave-early-buffer-ms.description: Maximum time an early wave PRESS or RELEASE may be held while searching for a predicted safe frame. Default 200ms ~= 48 physics steps at 240 TPS. Independent of the 5-frame reference setting.
